justification: Replace the curt SEPP 'doesn't apply to this zone' line with a value-rich, cited explanation that uses the lot's real zone, zone name, instrument (with the legislation link) and explains WHAT it means: a centre/business zone delivers housing through its own permitted uses (e.g. shop-top housing) rather than the Low & Mid-Rise pathway; a residential-but-empty case is treated as a load failure, not a 'no'. Adds getPlanningContext to share zone/instrument/lot context across cards.

pre_impl.existing_data: The brief already streams zone, zone_full, zone_epi and legislation_url on the planning_controls section; getPlanningContext walks the streamed sections to extract them (unwrapping DataFields). No new fetch.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: A 'no' was rendered as a terse one-liner that dropped the product's value; the context to explain the 'no' richly was already on the client.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new data. Adds getPlanningContext + isResidentialZone helpers and a SeppContextCard that consumes them; replaces the inline empty SEPP block.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Pure display; if zone context is missing the card falls back to generic phrasing ('this zone', 'the Local Environmental Plan') and omits the link.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: 'The Low & Mid-Rise Housing forms don't apply to this zone.' After: 'This lot is zoned E1 (Local Centre) under the Inner West LEP 2022 — not a residential zone. The Low & Mid-Rise reforms reach only R1–R4… housing here is delivered through the zone's own permitted uses, typically shop-top housing…' with the legislation link.

functions.name: getPlanningContext
functions.input: the streamed section events for this brief
functions.output: a PlanningContext with zone, zoneFull, zoneEpi, legislationUrl and lotAreaM2 unwrapped from the planning_controls and economics sections
functions.if_none: returns an empty object; the card uses generic fallback phrasing and omits the legislation link

values: N/A - no hardcoded regulatory values. Zone, instrument and the legislation URL come from the brief data; the explanatory copy describes the SEPP mechanism generically and hedges ('typically'), asserting nothing specific about this lot's permissions.
queries: N/A - no database or API query.

break_it.scenario: The zone is residential (R-zone) but standards are empty (a data load failure)
break_it.what_happens: claiming the zone excludes the forms would be wrong
break_it.repro: isResidentialZone(ctx.zone) routes R1-R5/RU5 to the 'couldn't load, re-run' branch, not the zone-excluded branch
break_it.how: the residential branch frames it as a load issue and points to the instrument, never a false exclusion

break_it.scenario: Planning context is missing (planning_controls not yet streamed)
break_it.what_happens: the card could render undefined zone text
break_it.repro: getPlanningContext returns {} and the card uses 'this zone' / 'the Local Environmental Plan' fallbacks
break_it.how: every field is optional with a generic fallback; the legislation link only renders when present

break_it.scenario: The copy asserts a specific permitted use for this lot (liability)
break_it.what_happens: claiming 'you can build shop-top housing here' would overstate
break_it.repro: the text says housing is 'typically' delivered via shop-top housing and directs the reader to the land use table for what THIS lot permits
break_it.how: the wording is general/educational and hedged; it points to the source rather than asserting the lot's permissions

post_merge.other_repo: N/A. PATTERN: this rich-explanation standard (zone + instrument + clause + meaning) will also be applied to the Granny Flat 'not permitted' reason when GF is decoupled to the gated async route, and to other empty states.
post_merge.manual_verify: Run a brief for an E1/commercial lot (e.g. 100 Ramsay): the SEPP card explains the zone, links the instrument, and explains how housing applies in a centre zone — not a one-line 'doesn't apply'.
